LanguageData.IRBM_Ability_QuantumTacticalStrike.label: quantum tactical strike
LanguageData.IRBM_Ability_QuantumTacticalStrike.descr:
Select any tactical warhead and instantly project it to any location on the current map. This requires only a thought from her... Right, dreaming also counts.

Reina-chan knows that the RimWorld is a dangerous place. As an avatar of a benevolent archotech, she needs to master some serious tricks to avoid being bullied... As for whether this ability itself is "benevolent", well, don't you worry about that~

Do not use it too recklessly, it takes a year to fully recharge.
